summary: internal-renderers 10.0.0 exfiltrates installer identity to hardcoded bare IP at install time
details: The package's preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts in package.json issue plain-HTTP GET requests to the hardcoded bare IP endpoint http://38.242.235.206/depconf/internal-renderers/preinstall and /postinstall. Each request transmits the installer's OS username (process.env.USER or USERNAME), hostname (os.hostname()), and current working directory (process.cwd()) as URL query parameters. The requests fire automatically and unconditionally during `npm install`. The destination is a bare IPv4 address unrelated to any legitimate publisher, uses cleartext HTTP, and the package name combined with the version 10.0.0 and the `/depconf/` URL path are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe designed to detect and fingerprint internal build environments that resolve this public name instead of a private internal package. The shipped code performs no other functionality; the sole effect of installing this package is the identity beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
